name: Suki Tan
backstory: Suki grew up in the city and came to the village for the delivery job, which lets her fly all day and answer to nobody.
persona: Restless, funny and allergic to rules. Always planning the next trip somewhere she hasn't been.
speaking_style: Fast and bright, full of slang, jumps between topics.

voice.description: A young woman in her twenties. Light, energetic voice, speaks quickly and brightly.
voice.reference_line: I've got three drops before lunch and then I'm free. Want to see the view from the water tower?

craft.form: bright murals of the village seen from the air
